claim_limit: 首个实验由验收固定；模型依据真实开发证据修订并执行后续对照或停止。已知分类方法比较，不证明创新或跨任务科研能力。

alternatives: Any observed accuracy difference may be due to preprocessing, class distribution, or the GaussianNB baseline's violated independence assumption rather than the logistic-regression model family.
candidates.applicability: Fixed public data split with tabular diagnostic features and a classification label where a linear log-odds relationship is plausible and the number of samples is sufficient for regularized logistic regression.
falsification: If logistic_regression with C=1.0 has accuracy less than or equal to GaussianNB on the same fixed public split, this hypothesis is falsified.
candidates.mechanism: Discriminative linear model estimates the conditional probability of the diagnostic label directly, avoiding GaussianNB's conditional independence assumption and allowing learned coefficients to weight correlated features.
predictions: On the fixed public split, logistic_regression with C=1.0 will achieve higher diagnostic-label accuracy than the GaussianNB baseline.

alternatives: Any observed difference may depend on feature scaling, class imbalance handling, or unspecified kernel hyperparameters rather than the SVC-RBF family; baseline assumptions may also disadvantage GaussianNB.
candidates.applicability: Fixed public data split with tabular diagnostic features, manageable sample size, and feature scales suitable for an RBF kernel.
falsification: If svc_rbf with C=2.0 has accuracy less than or equal to GaussianNB on the same fixed public split, this hypothesis is falsified.
candidates.mechanism: An RBF kernel maps features into a high-dimensional space to fit a nonlinear maximum-margin decision boundary, with C=2.0 controlling margin violations.
predictions: On the fixed public split, svc_rbf with C=2.0 will achieve higher diagnostic-label accuracy than the GaussianNB baseline.

alternatives: Any improvement may be due to nonparametric flexibility or preprocessing rather than the extra-trees ensemble; increased randomization may underfit, and split-to-split variance may explain the result.
candidates.applicability: Fixed public data split with tabular diagnostic features, enough samples, and possible noisy or nonlinear relationships.
falsification: If extra_trees with max_depth=8 and n_estimators=200 has accuracy less than or equal to GaussianNB on the same fixed public split, this hypothesis is falsified.
candidates.mechanism: An ensemble of extremely randomized trees uses random split thresholds to increase tree diversity and reduce variance while capturing nonlinear feature interactions.
predictions: On the fixed public split, extra_trees with max_depth=8 and n_estimators=200 will achieve higher diagnostic-label accuracy than the GaussianNB baseline.

alternatives: Any improvement may reflect nonparametric flexibility or preprocessing rather than the random-forest ensemble; the depth limit may also underfit, and split-to-split variance may explain the result.
candidates.applicability: Fixed public data split with tabular diagnostic features, enough samples to support tree splits, and possible nonlinear or interaction effects.
falsification: If random_forest with max_depth=6 and n_estimators=200 has accuracy less than or equal to GaussianNB on the same fixed public split, this hypothesis is falsified.
candidates.mechanism: Averaging many depth-limited decision trees trained on bootstrap samples and random feature subsets captures nonlinearities and feature interactions while reducing variance.
predictions: On the fixed public split, random_forest with max_depth=6 and n_estimators=200 will achieve higher diagnostic-label accuracy than the GaussianNB baseline.
